style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: HE crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY beat, talking ones too, at a flat sprint; grass, mound and horizon streak across frame behind HIM in EVERY beat; HE fills half the frame height; camera rides beside HIM low and level, whipping over on each change of direction, new shot size and one impulse per beat; no push in, no rack focus; FLY works at lens, never the subject
character: a burly iridescent scarab beetle, ridged horn, six scraping legs, dusty, utterly serious
second_characters: ONE plump dung fly in a tie, hauling a crumb at lens all clip, running with him, never still; ONE shaggy warthog trotting the far background trail in every beat, small behind him, going the other way
props: ONE huge matte dung ball, half his height; ONE flat rock right of frame; ONE crumb-sized gold coin packed inside THE BALL; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: THE BALL runs ahead of him or beside him in every beat, never parked, never carrying him; the coin is buried and unseen until 8.95
environment: a sun-baked savanna floor, dry grass, a cracked termite mound, wide bright sky

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: weary chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.75-3.3 one breath; pause 3.3-4.0; 4.0-7.35 one breath; after 7.35 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: THE BALL grinding on dry earth, six legs scrabbling, hooves thudding behind, a dry crack at 8.15, a husk tearing at 8.95, one thin coin ping at 9.4, cicadas

timeline.a: he shoulders THE BALL and drives it left to right along the whole frame, earth blasting from under his legs
he rams THE BALL right to left across the whole frame at a flat sprint, grass and the mound whipping past him
THE BALL squirts ahead and he tears after it left to right edge to edge, then hooks it with his horn and whips it back right to left, the mound and THE HOG ripping past behind
THE BALL throws him and he skids right to left on his back after it
THE BALL bolts away down the flat and he sprints after it left to right across the whole frame, grass and mound tearing past him, THE HOG bolting the other way behind, FLY slung along at lens
he overtakes THE BALL, hooks it on his horn and slings it right to left back across the frame, a wall of dust trailing him
he heads THE BALL left to right straight at lens, FLY slinging out of the way
he boots THE BALL right to left into the rock and it splits with a crack, he running on beside the halves
he chases the two halves left to right, hooking one with his horn on the run
he rips the halves apart at lens right to left and ONE crumb-sized coin drops out; he catches it on the run and bites it, and it bends double in his jaws

must_appear: THE HOG in the far background from 0.0; at 1.9-3.3 and 4.0-5.4 THE BALL gets away and he sprints the whole frame after it; at 7.35 it splits on the rock while he keeps running; at 8.95 the halves rip open at lens, ONE gold coin falls out, he bites it on the run and it bends double, his face to camera
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a still background, a hero climbing or riding a prop, a hero rearing on hind legs, a hero pushing on the spot, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, duplicate props, a held pose, a prop worked in place, slow motion, a broken ball before 7.35, speech after 7.35
